title: Word Count From a Text File
description: Write text to a file, then read it back and count the number of words in it.
code:
with open("sample.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write("Python makes file handling simple and readable")

with open("sample.txt", "r") as f:
    content = f.read()

word_count = len(content.split())
print("Word count:", word_count)
